STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_10836_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_10836_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_10836 
(
input        clk,
input        reset,
input  [2:0] address,
input        write,
input        read,
input  [31:0] writedata,
output reg [31:0] readdata,
input  [31:0] rx_data,
input        rx_dval,
input        rx_sop,
input        rx_eop,
input  [1:0] rx_mod,
input  [5:0] rx_err,
output reg   rx_rdy
);

reg  [31:0] number_packet;
reg  [31:0] packet_rx_ok;
reg  [31:0] packet_rx_error;
reg  [63:0] byte_rx_count;
reg  [63:0] cycle_rx_count;
reg  [31:0] receive_ctrl_status;

wire [21:0] receive_ctrl_status_wire;
wire start;
wire stop;
wire rx_done;

wire crcbad;
wire crcvalid;

reg  [31:0] crc_lfsr;
reg  [31:0] data_d1;
reg         valid_d1;

function [31:0] next_crc32;
    input [31:0] crc;
    input [31:0] data;
    integer i;
    begin
        next_crc32 = crc;
        for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
            if ((next_crc32[31] ^ data[i]) == 1'b1)
                next_crc32 = {next_crc32[30:0], 1'b0} ^ 32'h04C11DB7;
            else
                next_crc32 = {next_crc32[30:0], 1'b0};
        end
    end
endfunction

assign receive_ctrl_status_wire = 22'h0;
assign start = receive_ctrl_status[0];
assign stop = receive_ctrl_status[1];
assign rx_done = receive_ctrl_status[2];

always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        number_packet <= 32'h0;
    else if (write & address == 3'h0)
        number_packet <= writedata;
end

always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        packet_rx_ok <= 32'h0;
    else if (start)
        packet_rx_ok <= 32'h0;
    else if (~stop & crcvalid & ~crcbad)
        packet_rx_ok <= packet_rx_ok + 32'h1;
end

always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        packet_rx_error <= 32'h0;
    else if (start)
        packet_rx_error <= 32'h0;
    else if (~stop & crcvalid & crcbad)
        packet_rx_error <= packet_rx_error + 32'h1;
end

always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        byte_rx_count <= 64'h0;
    else if (start)
        byte_rx_count <= 64'h0;
    else if (~stop & rx_dval & rx_eop & rx_mod == 2'b01)
        byte_rx_count <= byte_rx_count + 64'h3;
    else if (~stop & rx_dval & rx_eop & rx_mod == 2'b10)
        byte_rx_count <= byte_rx_count + 64'h2;
    else if (~stop & rx_dval & rx_eop & rx_mod == 2'b11)
        byte_rx_count <= byte_rx_count + 64'h1;
    else if (~stop & rx_dval)
        byte_rx_count <= byte_rx_count + 64'h4;
end

always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        cycle_rx_count <= 64'h0;
    else if (start)
        cycle_rx_count <= 64'h0;
    else if (~stop & ~rx_done & byte_rx_count > 64'h0)
        cycle_rx_count <= cycle_rx_count + 64'h1;
end

always @ (receive_ctrl_status_wire) begin
    receive_ctrl_status[31:10] = receive_ctrl_status_wire;
end

always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        receive_ctrl_status[9:0] <= 10'h0;
    else if (write & address == 3'h7)
        receive_ctrl_status[1:0] <= writedata[1:0];
    else if (start)
        receive_ctrl_status[2:0] <= 3'b000;
    else if (rx_eop)
        receive_ctrl_status[9:4] <= rx_err[5:0];
    else if (crcvalid)
        receive_ctrl_status[3] <= crcbad;
    else if ((packet_rx_ok + packet_rx_error) == number_packet)
        receive_ctrl_status[2] <= 1'b1;
end

always @ (read or address or number_packet or packet_rx_ok or packet_rx_error or receive_ctrl_status) begin	
    readdata = 0;
    if (read) begin
        case (address)
            3'h0: readdata = number_packet;
            3'h1: readdata = packet_rx_ok;
            3'h2: readdata = packet_rx_error;
            3'h3: readdata = byte_rx_count[31:0];
            3'h4: readdata = byte_rx_count[63:32];
            3'h5: readdata = cycle_rx_count[31:0];
            3'h6: readdata = cycle_rx_count[63:32];
            3'h7: readdata = receive_ctrl_status;
            default: readdata = 32'h0;
        endcase
    end
end

always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        rx_rdy <= 1'b0;
    else 
        rx_rdy <= 1'b1;
end

always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        crc_lfsr <= 32'hFFFFFFFF;
        data_d1 <= 32'h0;
        valid_d1 <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        data_d1 <= rx_data;
        valid_d1 <= rx_dval;
        if (rx_dval) begin
            crc_lfsr <= next_crc32(crc_lfsr, rx_data);
        end
        if (rx_eop && valid_d1) begin
            crc_lfsr <= next_crc32(crc_lfsr, data_d1);
        end
    end
end

assign crcbad = (crc_lfsr != 32'hC704DD7B); // Example CRC value for checking
assign crcvalid = rx_eop;

endmodule
